instruction:
Create a native panel from the real Altium board file `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_board.PcbDoc` instead of exporting JSON. Save the result as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wifi_panel.PcbDoc` in Altium Designer.

Target panel constraints:
- The embedded source board document must still be `WiFi.PcbDoc`.
- The array must be `4` rows by `3` columns.
- `ROWSPACING` must be `1133.8583mil`.
- `COLSPACING` must be `1338.5827mil`.
- The array object must keep `MIRROR=TRUE` and `ORIGINMODE=1`.
- The resulting board must contain route tool-path data intended for panel fabrication.

This is a native `.PcbDoc` panel-editing task, not an external text-parameter transcription task.
source: Local Altium examples `Mini PC - WiFi/WiFi.PcbDoc` and `WiFi_panel.PcbDoc`; benchmark task restored from a text-only panel export degeneration.

command: if exist "C:\Program Files\Altium\AD26\X2.EXE" (echo OK) else (echo MISSING & exit /b 1)
